description: This Java class defines the data structure 'JobBusinessStepConfigData' used in the Fineract project for configuring job steps related to business logic in the Context of Chain Of Business (COB) processing.

classes.name: JobBusinessStepConfigData
classes.description: A data class representing the configuration for job business steps, including a job name and a list of business steps.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job.

methods.name: setJobName
methods.description: Sets the name of the job.

methods.name: getBusinessSteps
methods.description: Returns the list of business steps.

methods.name: setBusinessSteps
methods.description: Sets the list of business steps.
